```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) return(path)
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) stop("Project root not found")
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())

# Synthetic, mutually exclusive responses: no claim about an actual destination.
responses <- data.frame(
  code = c("A", "B", "C"),
  category = c("Vehicle privat", "Transport públic", "Altres mitjans"),
  count = c(50, 30, 20),
  colour = c("#9ecae1", "#fdd49e", "#c7e9c0"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
responses$percent <- 100 * responses$count / sum(responses$count)
correct_angles <- 360 * responses$count / sum(responses$count)
incorrect_angles <- c(90, 180, 90)

stopifnot(
  sum(responses$count) == 100,
  identical(responses$percent, c(50, 30, 20)),
  identical(correct_angles, c(180, 108, 72)),
  sum(incorrect_angles) == 360,
  all(incorrect_angles != correct_angles),
  identical(100 * incorrect_angles / 360, c(25, 50, 25))
)

xml_text <- function(text) {
  text <- gsub("&", "&amp;", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("<", "&lt;", text, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", text, fixed = TRUE)
}

# Exact SVG circular arcs make the geometric audit independent of rasterisation.
# Both versions keep radius, canvas, category order, colours and written shares.
draw_pie <- function(angles, path, description) {
  cx <- 230
  cy <- 230
  radius <- 180
  endpoints <- c(0, cumsum(angles))
  stopifnot(all(angles > 0), abs(tail(endpoints, 1) - 360) < 1e-10)
  point <- function(degrees, r = radius) {
    radians <- degrees * pi / 180
    c(cx + r * sin(radians), cy - r * cos(radians))
  }
  svg <- c(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="720" height="460" viewBox="0 0 720 460" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Mitjà principal en cent respostes simulades</title>',
    paste0('  <desc id="desc">', xml_text(description), '</desc>'),
    '  <rect width="720" height="460" fill="#ffffff"/>',
    '  <g font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" fill="#17202a">'
  )
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(responses))) {
    start <- point(endpoints[i])
    end <- point(endpoints[i + 1])
    centre <- point(mean(endpoints[c(i, i + 1)]), radius * 0.62)
    arc <- sprintf(
      "M %.3f %.3f L %.3f %.3f A %.3f %.3f 0 %d 1 %.3f %.3f Z",
      cx, cy, start[1], start[2], radius, radius,
      as.integer(angles[i] > 180), end[1], end[2]
    )
    svg <- c(svg,
      sprintf('    <path data-sector="%s" data-angle-deg="%.3f" data-labelled-percent="%.3f" d="%s" fill="%s" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/>',
              responses$code[i], angles[i], responses$percent[i], arc, responses$colour[i]),
      sprintf('    <text x="%.3f" y="%.3f" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22">%s</text>', centre[1], centre[2] - 12, responses$code[i]),
      sprintf('    <text x="%.3f" y="%.3f" text-anchor="middle" font-size="28" font-weight="700">%.0f%%</text>', centre[1], centre[2] + 22, responses$percent[i])
    )
    legend_y <- 152 + (i - 1) * 68
    svg <- c(svg,
      sprintf('    <rect x="440" y="%d" width="24" height="24" fill="%s"/>', legend_y, responses$colour[i]),
      sprintf('    <text x="478" y="%d" font-size="20">%s · %s</text>', legend_y + 19, responses$code[i], xml_text(responses$category[i]))
    )
  }
  svg <- c(svg, '  </g>', '</svg>')
  writeLines(enc2utf8(svg), path, useBytes = TRUE)
}

output_dir <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
draw_pie(
  incorrect_angles,
  file.path(output_dir, "pie-sector-audit-incorrect.svg"),
  "Exercici deliberadament incorrecte. Les etiquetes indiquen 50, 30 i 20 per cent, però els sectors ocupen 90, 180 i 90 graus: un quart, mitja volta i un quart. Dades simulades."
)
draw_pie(
  correct_angles,
  file.path(output_dir, "pie-sector-audit-correct.svg"),
  "Correcció de l'exercici: les mateixes etiquetes de 50, 30 i 20 per cent corresponen a sectors de 180, 108 i 72 graus. Dades simulades."
)
```
